title: Differentiating a local marginal balance
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement. Use the continuous averaged generator and differentiate the local integral identity.
target_statement: For a weakly continuous curve of laws $\rho_t$, set $F(t)=\int g\,d\rho_t$ and $B(t)=\int A(t,x)\,d\rho_t(x)$. A local signed balance about $s$ gives the ordinary derivative of $F$ at $s$.
